# Cassandra Orbit

> Pick a satellite and find out who comes close to it in the next 24 hours. It screens 13,000+ tracked objects with SGP4 orbit physics, shows the close passes on a 3D globe, and explains them in plain language.

Cassandra Orbit is a screening demo built on public orbital elements (CelesTrak TLEs). Distances are estimates, not an operational collision probability.

- [Source code](https://github.com/aristotile-dev/Space-Debris-Alert-Dashboard)
